title: BDSR: Lung-Cancer Survival
summary: A strict port of the BDSR lung-cancer example using exact survival::lung data, matching results, and three source-matched BioLang Kaplan-Meier figures.

source.title: Biological Data Science with R — Survival Analysis, sections 9.2.2–9.2.3
source.note: The selected source scope is ported with exact data, calculations, parameters, printed results, and three figures generated by BioLang with source-matched curves and presentation. No synthetic data or copied source images are used. The adaptation and survival dataset retain their stated non-MIT terms.

series.title: Biological Data Science with R
series.chapter: Chapter 9 · Survival analysis · selected worked example

datasets.title: NCCTG Lung Cancer Data
datasets.source: The cancer/lung object from the R survival package, serialized by the Rdatasets archive without changing its ten source variables or 228 observations.
datasets.citation: Loprinzi CL et al. Prospective evaluation of prognostic variables from patient-completed questionnaires. Journal of Clinical Oncology. 1994;12(3):601–607; survival R package.
datasets.rights: The survival package is LGPL (>= 2). This exact dataset serialization is excluded from the repository MIT grant.
